WITH step_s1 AS (SELECT geoid AS fips, value FROM geo_values_all WHERE level = $2 AND code = $1 AND year = (SELECT max(year) FROM geo_values_all WHERE level = $2 AND code = $1)),
     step_s2 AS (SELECT fips, value FROM step_s1 WHERE value < $3),
     step_s3 AS (SELECT u.geoid AS fips, (SELECT min(ST_Distance(k.pt::geography, f.geom::geography)) FROM table_7fd78ade6d9847dab7aff72866124f79_hospitals f WHERE f.geom && ST_Expand(k.pt, k.d0 * 1.01 / (110574 * cos(radians(least(abs(ST_Y(k.pt)) + k.d0 / 110574, 89.9)))))) / 1609.344 AS value FROM geo_unit u LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT u.pt, ST_Distance(u.pt::geography, f.geom::geography) AS d0 FROM table_7fd78ade6d9847dab7aff72866124f79_hospitals f ORDER BY f.geom <-> u.pt LIMIT 1) k ON true WHERE u.level = $4),
     step_s4 AS (SELECT fips, value FROM step_s3 WHERE value > $5),
     step_s5 AS (SELECT c.geoid AS fips, COUNT(f.*)::double precision AS value FROM geo_unit c LEFT JOIN transit_stops f ON c.geom && f.geom AND ST_Intersects(c.geom, f.geom) WHERE c.level = $6 GROUP BY c.geoid),
     step_s6 AS (SELECT u.geoid AS fips, (SELECT min(ST_Distance(k.pt::geography, f.geom::geography)) FROM transit_stops f WHERE f.geom && ST_Expand(k.pt, k.d0 * 1.01 / (110574 * cos(radians(least(abs(ST_Y(k.pt)) + k.d0 / 110574, 89.9)))))) / 1609.344 AS value FROM geo_unit u LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT u.pt, ST_Distance(u.pt::geography, f.geom::geography) AS d0 FROM transit_stops f ORDER BY f.geom <-> u.pt LIMIT 1) k ON true WHERE u.level = $7),
     step_s7 AS (SELECT fips, value FROM step_s6 WHERE value <= $8),
     step_s8 AS (SELECT a.fips, a.value FROM step_s2 a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM step_s4 b WHERE b.fips = a.fips)),
     step_s9 AS (SELECT a.fips, a.value FROM step_s8 a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM step_s7 b WHERE b.fips = a.fips)),
     step_s10 AS (SELECT a.fips, a.value FROM step_s9 a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM step_s5 b WHERE b.fips = a.fips))
SELECT r.fips, g.name, g.state_fp, r.value,
       CASE WHEN g.geom IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ST_AsGeoJSON(g.geom) END AS geometry
FROM step_s10 r
LEFT JOIN (SELECT geoid AS fips, name, state_fp, COALESCE(geom_z12, geom) AS geom FROM geo_unit WHERE level = 'tract') g USING (fips)
ORDER BY r.value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5000
